feasibility.finding: The numeric bed and sum intervals alone admit solutions. The frozen sparse fixture signals and permitted no-relevel/no-recipe-change architecture demonstrably fail; post-tail stems do not prove an upper bound over every legal alternate composition. Fixed finite event energy contributes approximately E_event/T to a sustained non-silent programme, so imposing a fixed 2-3 LU average completion on arbitrarily sparse passages conflicts with the atmospheric/density intent. Averages and transient headroom are different quantities.
feasibility.recommendation: Correct the five fixtures' acceptance classification explicitly rather than adding activity or changing the music to satisfy an unrelated average. No new event-conditioned orchestration is proposed.
